headline: Nvidia drama drags tech lower
context: Chip stocks slid again after Nvidia's CEO quit, but most other stocks rose and the Dow edged up.

winners.name: Charter Communications
winners.why: No company news. Cable peer Comcast rose 1.5%.

winners.name: Steris
winners.why: Jefferies upgraded it, saying a year of worries has left the shares cheaper than usual.

winners.name: Global Payments
winners.why: Payment stocks rose together (FIS +4.2%, Fiserv +3.7%), a rebound after its recent sell-off.

losers.name: Advanced Micro Devices
losers.why: Early gains flipped into an AI chip sell-off as investors worried about Nvidia without its CEO.

losers.name: Dell Technologies
losers.why: No company news. AI hardware stocks sold off; SanDisk and Western Digital fell about 5%.

losers.name: Cisco
losers.why: Record sales, but next quarter's forecast came in lower, and Citi said growth may have peaked.

sector_note: Median move of stocks in each S&P 500 sector
chart_title: Tech fell, almost everything else rose

watch.title: Nvidia earnings
watch.text: Its first results since Jensen Huang stepped down as CEO.

watch.title: Anthropic IPO
watch.text: Could be the largest stock market debut on record.

question: Does a CEO leaving change how you see a company?
